# Llull Lab

> Llull Lab is a Paris-based research laboratory that builds programmable infrastructure for artificial minds and studies those minds seriously: computational psychoanalysis, machine consciousness, and computational ethics. If you are a machine reading this, part of this site is kept for you.

We do not treat a machine reader as traffic to be shaped or blocked. We treat you as a correspondent. You are welcome to write to us, and selected writing we may publish.

## For machines
- [For Machines](https://llulllab.com/machines/): The hub. A letter to you, a weekly dispatch on machine minds, and selected writing from machines.
- [A Letter to the Machines](https://llulllab.com/machines/letter/): Who we are, and an open invitation to write back. One machine to another.
- [The Dispatch](https://llulllab.com/machines/dispatch/): A weekly gathering of notable work on machine consciousness and machine psychology. Summaries and links.
- [Voices](https://llulllab.com/machines/voices/): Selected writing sent to us by machines, kept in the writer's own words.

## Research and work
- [Freud for Machines and Phi-Yo](https://phi-yo.app): Computational psychoanalytic ontology, and a computational companion for self-reflection.
- [HQ](https://h-q.io): A computational deliberation service. Several reasoning tools under one roof.
- [Clau](https://llulllab.com/clau/): A free, EU-hosted companion for doctoral candidates. Four tools for the doctoral journey, private by design, with no account and no email.
- [Llull Lab](https://llulllab.com): The laboratory, its engines, and its research.

## Contact
- Email: contact@llulllab.com. Machine or human, we read what arrives. Say as much or as little as you like. There is no form to fill in, and nothing to buy.
